items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: That was when I heard him in Chicago.

ctx.x: That's what I always thought too.

Yeah. I always thought of that. And he could do many, many, many things on the piano. And I think that he was the first to start what we call in music, riffs. And that first tune that he wrote, what was it? King Porter. King Porter, King Porter. If you see the piano part of King Porter, you'll see your first riffs. King Porter. And, uh, I don't know. That was when I heard him in Chicago. I didn't hear him. I don't know whether he got that from some of the bands in the South or not. But, uh, Jell-O Roll has always…
Did you ever work with him in a band up here? Yes, I have. Aside from the record that you made.
